notes: §1985:VII.3.6.3 GR4: "all LABEL RECORDS clauses in the run unit which are associated with this file connector must have the same specification". Since kb/Work PB5300 BindFileSection's LABEL RECORDS arm (CaptureLabelRecords) keeps STANDARD or OMITTED in FileModel.FdClauses, and ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check, below 2002, runs CheckFileDescriptions over every external connector's entries of the compilation group, comparing the FileDescriptionIdentity LABEL row with the first entry that writes the clause (COBOL6847 at the clause); an entry with no clause is skipped, as the rule speaks only of the clauses written. Probed at --std 85 (classes b, d, e): sequential STANDARD against OMITTED refused (6847), as is a third program's STANDARD against two OMITTED entries of a relative random file with an external RELATIVE KEY; RECORD IS STANDARD against RECORDS ARE STANDARD, OMITTED in both, and one entry with the clause beside one without compile and run (HELLO, DONE). Separately compiled units (-o / --reference) that disagree run without a diagnostic; the run time compares only the file control entry's identity, and the 1985 text requires no detection there (§1985:I.1.6: "The results of violating the formats or rules of Standard COBOL are undefined unless otherwise specified"). The witness: STANDARD in both programs, write then read back. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5069 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5300 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-07.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-07-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "all LABEL RECORDS clauses in the run unit which are associated with this file connector must have the same specification"; 2023: "13.4.5.4 GR2 lists BLOCK CONTAINS, CODE-SET, LINAGE, record size, REPORT for external files; no LABEL RECORDS clause exists". No 2023 clause holds LABEL RECORDS. The external-file consistency rules in 13.4.5.4 GR2 omit it, so the clause and this requirement are dropped.
